detail: No ACK was seen after the data byte -- the slave never pulled SDA low on the 9th clock of the data phase. No STOP condition (SDA rising while SCL is high) was observed on the bus -- the transaction never terminated correctly. The data bytes captured on the bus did not match the required [0x3C] payload. The bus showed more than one STOP condition (or none); v1 requires exactly one STOP at the end of the transaction. The transaction did not contain exactly one address byte followed by the expected number of data bytes.
